name: Arabia Falcon Insurance SAOG
hq: Landmark Building, Ground Floor, Boushar P.O.Box 2279 PC 112 Ruwi Sultan...
description: Arabia Falcon Insurance Company SAOG (AFIC) is a Muscat-based composite insurer formed through the merger of two Omani insurance businesses, drawing on more than 70 years of regional underwriting heritage. The company writes personal and corporate general insurance—principally Motor and Property & Casualty lines—alongside Life and Unified Credit Life policies, supported by an investment portfolio that contributes a substantial share of net earnings. Following a strategic portfolio exit from medical underwriting in the second half of 2025, AFIC is focusing on pricing discipline, claims management, and underwriting profitability across its core lines.
highlights: Reported 9M 2026 Gross Written Premiums of OMR 22.2M (-3% YoY) after exiting medical underwriting in H2 2025 (which had contributed OMR 2.0M in 9M 2025), with IFRS 17 insurance revenue of OMR 16.6M.
Generated 9M 2026 net profit of OMR 1.042M, supported by OMR 1.833M in investment income and OMR 221k in net insurance service results despite elevated claims inflation.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of N/A and Net Profit of N/A (Total Assets: OMR 80.60M).
